en: The Triplet of the Wholesome (Kusalattika), The Triplet of Limited Objects (Parittārammaṇattika)

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor of limited object, there arises a neutral state of limited object by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor of exalted object, there arises a wholesome state of exalted object by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Nine under root; ... pe ... three under result; ... pe ... nine under non-disappearance.

Conditioned by a wholesome state that does not have an immeasurable object, a wholesome state with an immeasurable object arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. There are six under root; ... pe ... three under result; ... pe ... six under non-disappearance.
